title: Shop Counter - The Counter Bell
_note: Game-wide SHOP interior cue (every chandlery, general store and kite-maker's). snes register, small-room: 5 voices. 116 BPM, 4/4 with a light SWING written as quarter-triplet + eighth-triplet pairs, Bb major. Form AABA, 32 bars (~66s): A = the bouncy counter tune (F-G-Bb-D lift, Cm-F7 turn home); every 4-bar phrase ends in a gap the DOORBELL fills with its bright falling 'ding-ding' (F5-D5) - the hook. B = an Eb-major middle that wanders the shelves (D7 to Gm, C7 to F7) and rings the bell upward as a question. The last bar walks D4-E4 chromatically into the bar-1 F4. Pluck = pizzicato/marimba off-beat comp; tri_bass bouncy staccato root-fifth; brushes only.
